articles.title: BIS project finds tokenization could make cross-border payments faster, safer
articles.snippet: Project Agorá, backed by major central banks, will now move toward "real-value" testing to settle tokenized central bank money and bank deposits on blockchain rails.

articles.title: Crypto IPOs could create massive $1 trillion market amid tokenization wave, Jefferies says
articles.snippet: The Wall Street investment bank expects a wave of crypto and blockchain public listings over the next two years as institutional investors shift their focus from speculative trading to real-world financial infrastructure.

articles.title: Solana DEX Orca launches new marketplace for tokenized real-world assets
articles.snippet: The launch comes as crypto companies increasingly focus on tokenizing traditional financial assets, a market many in the industry see as a major growth opportunity.

articles.title: Huawei's New Benchmark Gives AI Agents Months of Your Life—Then Watches Them Fail
articles.snippet: Claw-Anything simulates a real digital existence and asks AI assistants to handle it. GPT-5.5, the best model available, scored 34.5%.

articles.title: $1.3B Worth of BlackRock's IBIT Changes Hands in Dark Pool Sale
articles.snippet: A $1.3 billion off-exchange IBIT block sale shook Bitcoin Tuesday, but experts say the real test is yet to come.
